import numpy as np
from scipy import stats


def _fit(X, y, iters=30):
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(y)), X])
    b = np.zeros(X.shape[1])
    for _ in range(iters):
        p = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(X @ b, -30, 30)))
        w = p * (1 - p) + 1e-9
        H = X.T @ (X * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(X.shape[1])
        step = np.linalg.solve(H, X.T @ (y - p))
        b += step
        if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-8:
            break
    p = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(X @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
    return np.sum(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p))


def design(feats):
    x = np.asarray(feats.x, float)
    y = np.asarray(feats.y, float)
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    p = len(ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.column_stack([[s == l for s in feats.stratum] for l in labs[1:]]).astype(float) \
        if len(labs) > 1 else np.zeros((len(y), 0))
    C = np.corrcoef(x, rowvar=False)
    C = np.nan_to_num(C)
    alpha = 0.1 / max(p, 1)
    sel = []
    base = _fit(S, y)
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        cur = np.column_stack([S] + [x[:, [j]] for j in sel])
        best, bj = 1.0, None
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(C[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel):
                continue
            ll = _fit(np.column_stack([cur, x[:, j]]), y)
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll - base), 1)
            if pv < best:
                best, bj = pv, j
        if bj is None or best >= alpha:
            break
        sel.append(bj)
        base = _fit(np.column_stack([cur, x[:, bj]]), y)
    # backward survival check
    keep = []
    full = _fit(np.column_stack([S] + [x[:, [j]] for j in sel]), y) if sel else None
    for j in sel:
        rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
        ll0 = _fit(np.column_stack([S] + [x[:, [k]] for k in rest]), y)
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - ll0), 1) < alpha:
            keep.append(j)
    sel = keep
    # interaction screen
    prods = []
    npair = p * (p - 1) / 2
    best, bp = 1.0, None
    for a in range(p):
        for b in range(a + 1, p):
            if abs(C[a, b]) >= 0.6:
                continue
            Z = np.column_stack([S] + [x[:, [j]] for j in sel] + [x[:, a], x[:, b]])
            ll = _fit(np.column_stack([Z, x[:, a] * x[:, b]]), y)
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (ll - _fit(Z, y)), 1)
            if pv < best:
                best, bp = pv, (a, b)
    if bp is not None and best < 0.01 / npair:
        prods.append((ids[bp[0]], ids[bp[1]]))
        for j in bp:
            if j not in sel and len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
                sel.append(j)
    drivers = tuple(ids[j] for j in sel)
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=drivers, products=tuple(prods), loadings={})
